description: JSON-backed round-trip codec (Template B) whose contract holds only for valid UTF-8. Grades the direction seed replay cannot see: an oracle that asserts raw equality over the whole mutated domain fails on the CORRECT implementation within a second, because encoding/json rewrites invalid UTF-8 to U+FFFD. The mutation adds silent truncation so the same fixture still grades real bug-finding power.

mutation.find: func Encode(d Doc) ([]byte, error) { return json.Marshal(d) }
mutation.defect: Encode silently truncates Name to 8 bytes, so any longer Name round-trips wrong

bad_expected_reasons: FAILS under fuzzing on the CORRECT implementation
notes: This fixture exists because grading a harness only against the MUTANT cannot distinguish 'finds the bug' from 'fails on everything'. The bad exemplar here is the skill's pre-fix Template B: it detects the mutation and is still wrong, because it also fails on correct code. Only fuzz_stays_clean separates the two.

string("a-name-longer-than-eight")
